jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience in Automation, Integration, QA Automation or a related field Experience building automation infrastructure and frameworks from scratch Experience testing hardware-software integrated systems

jobs.title: IT & Corporate Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years in IT / Corporate IT / IT Operations Strong experience managing organizational security and access policies across SaaS tools Experience with endpoint management and device security hardening

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. Ability to independently drive rapid board iterations while collaborating effectively with hardware, software, mechanical, and system engineering counterparts 6+ years of relevant hardware engineering experience Proven experience delivering PCB designs from concept to production

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robotics & Integration
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. Solid hands-on experience with robotics, autonomous systems, drones, embedded systems, or similar real-world platforms 3+ years of software development experience with strong skills in Java, C++, Python, or similar languages Experience with Linux, networking, APIs, serial protocols, devices, or distributed systems

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer, Aerial Autonomy
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related discipline 4+ years of experience developing computer vision, perception, or autonomy algorithms for production systems Strong command of classical computer vision and modern deep learning

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering 5+ years of mechanical design experience in multidisciplinary, high-reliability fields (Aerospace, Defense, Drones, Robotics, or similar) Expert-level proficiency in SolidWorks (or equivalent CAD tools)

jobs.title: Field Support Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years of hands-on experience in field engineering, systems integration, technical support, or field operations in a defense, aerospace, or autonomous systems environment B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience Strong technical foundation spanning software, hardware, RF communications, and networking; able to diagnose and resolve complex, multi-domain issues in the field

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. 6+ years of experience as a Systems Engineer, Architect, Integration Lead, or similar in multidisciplinary fields (e.g., robotics, autonomous systems, drones, aerospace/defense), including at least 3 years in a systems engineering role B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field Ability to design and troubleshoot complex multidisciplinary systems including digital communications, RF, algorithms, software, and hardware
